stories.title: Xi, Putin blast Western sanctions as Trump lands in China for APEC
stories.summary: China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin used the APEC summit in Shenzhen to denounce Western sanctions, with Putin calling Western powers 'former hegemons,' as Donald Trump arrived for a three-way meeting.

stories.title: Trump says US concluded a 'very big trade deal' with Philippines
stories.summary: Trump announced during a Manila state visit that the US had consummated 'the biggest trade deal we've ever made,' but Philippine officials said only an understanding on economic cooperation was reached and nothing was signed.

stories.title: Iran fires on US air base in Kuwait after US strikes on Qeshm Island
stories.summary: Iran said it targeted US drone and missile sites in Kuwait overnight in retaliation for American strikes on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, widening Tehran's attacks on Gulf neighbors.

stories.title: Xi says Russia and China should 'lead' push to a multipolar world
stories.summary: At the APEC summit in Shenzhen, Xi Jinping said Beijing and Moscow should jointly lead the shift away from a US-dominated order, as the two leaders projected strategic alignment on trade and energy.

stories.title: Anthropic prices blockbuster IPO today; ANT begins trading Thursday
stories.summary: The Claude maker sets its final IPO price today (825M shares at $70-$78, up to ~$1.4T valuation) and starts trading on Nasdaq as ANT on Nov. 19, the biggest public test yet of the AI boom.

stories.title: Microsoft Entra adds AI agent identity, passkeys and access controls at Ignite
stories.summary: Microsoft's Ignite 2026 identity updates extend Entra to AI agents, including ones Microsoft didn't build, adding agent identity, conditional access and an MCP firewall, mostly in preview.

stories.title: Ohio State climbs to No. 14 in latest CFP rankings
stories.summary: After five teams ranked ahead of them lost, the Buckeyes jumped six spots to No. 14 in Tuesday's College Football Playoff rankings, within striking distance of the final at-large berth with two weeks left.

stories.title: Georgia stays No. 1; Ohio State jumps six spots to No. 14 in CFP rankings
stories.summary: The committee's third ranking kept Georgia on top and moved the 7-3 Buckeyes to No. 14 after their win over Northwestern, with Oregon at No. 13 standing between Ohio State and a playoff berth.

stories.title: Ohio State moves into CFP 'bubble territory' at No. 14
stories.summary: On3's breakdown: the Buckeyes still need help to crack the 12-team field, but wins over No. 15 Iowa and No. 8 Indiana keep their resume alive with two weeks to go.

stories.title: Piastri set for 10-place grid penalty at Las Vegas GP
stories.summary: McLaren confirms Oscar Piastri will take a new internal combustion engine for Las Vegas, triggering a 10-place grid drop, while both McLarens get Mercedes' long-awaited ADUO turbo upgrade.

stories.title: Mercedes to run upgraded turbo on Antonelli's car only in Vegas
stories.summary: Toto Wolff says the new ADUO turbo goes to Kimi Antonelli alone in Las Vegas; fitting it to George Russell would trigger a five-place penalty the team won't risk in his fight for P2.

stories.title: Hamilton to sit out Vegas FP1; Beganovic takes the Ferrari seat
stories.summary: Ferrari confirmed Dino Beganovic will drive Lewis Hamilton's car in Thursday's first practice in Las Vegas, while Bernie Ecclestone questioned whether Fred Vasseur is the right leader for the team.

stories.title: Leclerc expects a 'difficult' Las Vegas weekend for Ferrari
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc concedes Ferrari likely won't end its winless run since July in Las Vegas, citing cold temperatures, even as the team is well placed to seal second in the constructors' championship.

stories.title: Central Ohio may hit 3M residents later than forecast
stories.summary: New Mid-Ohio Regional Planning Commission projections put the 15-county region at 2.7M-3.04M people by 2050, up to 450,000 fewer than its last forecast, with local deaths expected to outpace births by 2040.

stories.title: Franklin County deputy suspended over Flock camera misuse
stories.summary: A Franklin County sheriff's deputy was suspended after allegedly misusing Flock license-plate camera data, NBC4 reports.

stories.title: OSU-area student hit by repeat car break-ins questions police response
stories.summary: A student near North High Street says his and his girlfriend's cars were broken into three times in two months, and that police declined to act despite video and AirPods location data; he's taking the complaint to City Council.
